comparison.objective: Break four installed HELICOIL tangs and recover them; record opens a vacuum-sealed jar and sets down its lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate needs recessed coaxial mandrel control, bimanual hammer impact, and fragment recovery; record needs rim levering, counter-torque, and lid twisting.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contact-loaded fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, and no damage; record requires seal release, 80° loosening, stable upright jar, and lid placement. Candidate numeric fracture/damage tolerances are not yet specified.
comparison.reason: Levering and rotary opening do not test impact-driven notch fracture or small-fragment recovery.
